Name: Addar
ModernLocation: Southern border of Judah, near Kadesh-barnea
Description: A point on Judah's southern boundary in the allotment list, reached after Kadesh-barnea and Hezron on the way toward Karkaa.
BiblicalSignificance: Addar shows how precisely the promised land was bounded: even a border town in the wilderness edge belonged to the inheritance.
